question: Can the preserved v25 planner be used on the exact minimum Bloodfire runtime without private-order dependence, live-state mutation, invalid actions or silent reactivation of disabled effects?
scope: Controller-interface qualification only; no old scientific study, sample, fitted weight, new product law or matched-value population is executed.
source_selection: Use only the bound legacy/v8/v9/v13/v15/v17/v18/v19 source layers and the already recorded v21 assembly corrections. Preserve every heuristic and original two-sample/twelve-step horizon. Explicitly copy existing Bloodfire intervention flags into forecast rules; this is the only new compatibility adapter.
gates: Complete fixed matrix and all reflected game states, query values/actions, native return/events and source identities
Exact off and Dusk native/query outcomes versus baseline on the whole matrix
Hidden RNG/seed/run-id/draw-order intervention changes neither canonical model nor planned action/value; public state multiset unchanged
No live run/combat/content/rule-switch mutation by planning
Every returned action is legal, native execution accepts paid plays, and no lethal BloodRite is selected in the named source-lethal fixtures
Disabled intervention switches survive cloning; unadapted source demonstrates the specific reset risk
No ignored import/parse/native diagnostic; tests and offline readout agree

decision.pass: Current runtime interface is qualified only. A separately frozen matched-cost value experiment is required before relying on this planner for package evidence.
decision.fail: Retain the exact finite counterexample; do not claim universal planner failure or alter fixtures/weights to rescue this decision. A demonstrable implementation defect may be repaired under the unchanged claim with explicit red/green regression.
decision.inconclusive: Preserve all partial outputs and identify the failing delivery condition; no invented terminal or new rows.

independence: Constructed fixed cases, zero independent package confirmation samples. Public clone is not an independent source/runtime oracle. Node O/E0/E1 remain sealed.
signed_controls: No official balance_pilot, balance_policy or balance_sim file is edited. No planned wrapper is installed on a RandomBuild/RandomPlay path. Future integration must separately verify this boundary.
non_goals: No rerun of v25 or old panels
No new sampler root or gameplay candidate
